title: CRIC Data Quality and Validation Specification
summary: Defines CRIC's quality dimensions, layered validators V0-V8, QualityAssessment and validation-report schemas, quality flags, and promotion gates.
notes: Path sits under docs/CRIC-PRD-v0.1/ (weak PRD path signal) and the doc closes with a 'v0.1 Acceptance Criteria' section (PRD signal), but dominant content is implementation contracts: layered validator definitions, YAML node/report schemas, enumerated quality flags, promotion gates. SPEC > PRD under the ambiguity rule. No ADR status field or Decision/Consequences sections. No markdown links or filename mentions, so cross_refs is empty. Output filename suffix is a stable disambiguator, not a computed SHA-256 (no shell tool available to hash the path).
